title: littletiles-create-compat
description: 实现create模组中动态结构中littletiles方块的渲染、方向旋转兼容。enables rendering and rotation compatibility of LittleTiles blocks within dynamic structures from the Create mod.
body:
一个为4Y_abc定制的mod公开，**实现create模组中动态结构中littletiles方块的渲染、方向旋转兼容**

原先create机械动力动态结构中的littletiles方块是看不见，而且解体时方块的朝向是原方块组装前的方向，该mod解决了这两个问题，实现了可见和方向改变。以满足使用littletiles来造火车等需求。

_但该mod没有为动态结构上的littletiles赋予方块碰撞箱和交互功能。_

A custom mod for 4Y_abc is now publicly released. **It fixes rendering and rotation compatibility issues of Little Tiles blocks inside dynamic structures from the Create mod.**
Originally, LittleTiles blocks placed on Create dynamic structures were invisible. Additionally, when the structure disassembled, the blocks would revert to their original orientation before assembly. This mod resolves both problems, making the blocks visible and correctly retaining their rotated directions, which supports building vehicles like trains with LittleTiles.

_Note that this mod does not add collision boxes or interactable functions to Little Tiles blocks on dynamic structures._
